waivers.reason: U7 is the ESP32-WROVER-E module, which carries its own 3V3 decoupling on its module PCB. C30 (22 uF) and C31 (100 nF) are bulk/backup at the module pin, and the loop the check measures includes the module's GND pad distance. Espressif's module reference design needs only a 10-22 uF + 0.1 uF pair near pin 2, with no loop limit.

waivers.reason: U3 (INA186A1) reads R1 (10 mOhm) about 5.6% high: 0.441 mOhm of VBUS_IN copper before R18's tap and 0.124 mOhm of VBUS before R19's (check_kelvin, good to about +/-30% of that copper). No layout change: it reads high, so the governor and DJ direct's contract trip act early, which is the safe direction, at a cost of about 7 W of the 126 W limit at 28 V until bring-up. Copper's tempco moves the figure by under 1% over a 40 C rise, so a gain set at bring-up removes it (ISENSE_V_PER_A, docs/firmware.md). Moving the taps means a new isolated track across the input pour and new Gerbers on an order-ready board.
